'''Waste-reclamation units''' were used for waste disposal aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Whole items, such as glassware, was placed in the unit once used.<ref name="AJ15">{{JournalCite|15|Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters: The Shard}}</ref>
